name: apple-voicememos-mcp
description: List and transcribe Voice Memos recordings on this Mac, on device
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift for Voice Memos.

Voice Memos has no framework and is not scriptable, so recordings are reached as files and transcribed with Apple's Speech framework.

Transcription is forced on-device: the audio never leaves this Mac. It is also slow, so transcribe by id rather than sweeping the library.

The grant for transcription appears under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Speech Recognition.

Nothing here deletes or modifies a recording.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: recordings_status
tools.description: Reports which recording library this server can reach, whether speech recognition is granted, whether the on-device model for the recognition locale is installed, and where exports and cached…

tools.name: recordings_list
tools.description: Lists recordings with their id, name, date, duration and folder, newest first. Returns one line each and says how many matches were withheld.

tools.name: recording_get
tools.description: Returns everything stored about one or more recordings: name, file name, full path, folder, creation and modification dates, duration, size and file type. No audio and no transcript — use…

tools.name: recording_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes recordings to text with Apple's Speech framework, forced to on-device recognition: the audio never leaves this Mac and no network request is made. Needs the Speech Recognition…

tools.name: recording_export
tools.description: Copies a recording's audio file into the configured export folder. The original is never moved, renamed or touched.
